structure_proposals.why: You asked on 23 August whether four sets is right for such a small muscle group, and the answer is no — Push B already opens with four sets of overhead press and Push A adds three cable lateral raises on top, so this makes it the three sets you actually did that night, all of them at fifteen reps.

The cable reverse curl asks twelve to fifteen reps and your last five Pull B nights have never once put a set above twelve — eleven, eleven, eleven at 37.5 on both 15 and 25 August — so the weight can never move, and asking ten to twelve makes the twelves you already did in July the thing that earns the next step.
